title: Use calibrated contribution value throughout the complete session loop
goal: Use qualified forecasts to allocate the next useful work and connect all model mechanisms through one recoverable session loop with an accountable final result.
scope: Implement VocValue beside OrdinalValue and FixedWorkflow: calibrate profile-hint success, calculate weighted p × belief jump × remaining belief gap, divide by expected cost and apply θ_min. Define explicit safe handling for zero/unknown cost and unsupported forecasts without creating infinite-value work.

Merge agent proposals and policy templates for Unmet/Supported/Contradicted criteria. Filter accepted dependencies, actual needs, effective write conflicts, producer independence, purpose budget and parallel capacity; every selected contribution declares its expected effect and expected/p90 cost.

Connect learned calibration/reputation to ResponseThreshold, CalibratedValuePerCost, CheapestAdequate and reviewer/attempt strength comparisons while preserving explicit raw/uncalibrated fallback. Remove fixed W1 selection bypasses; actual decisions retain their exact policy and input provenance.

Complete A1 across all role outcomes and invocation/Board/lease/consequence/user wakeups. Apply authorized strategy/parameter selections at recorded boundaries through the model’s named ports without consumer rewrites. Integrate native backends, scoped recovery and stable finalization; after user stop deliver DeterministicReport without new model calls, and permit learning only after Delivered within unprotected budget.

Apply A13 stop rules with protected verification and ResourcePolicy-derived reporting capacity. Preserve checked work on StopPreserving and recover without duplicate assignments/settlement/merge/learning/report or lost user decisions. Report receipts are settled or conservatively held before delivery; A7/A8/report audit use current applicable evidence.
acceptance: A real scenario chooses different useful contributions under VocValue versus OrdinalValue/FixedWorkflow, records gain/probability/cost/basis, and refuses an otherwise high-scoring proposal that violates capability, dependency, independence, budget or path ownership.

Complete sessions demonstrate agent initiative, changed awards, responsibility transfer, objections and adaptation compared with the fixed control, alongside breadth, alternatives, knowledge and consequences. Both positive and harmful/ineffective organizational outcomes remain traceable to selected mechanisms, costs and unmet criteria.

Reopening at allocation, verification, merge, reporting or asynchronous-learning boundaries preserves deterministic decisions and user controls without duplicating effects. Every used policy and native backend is reachable through its real consumer rather than a dead configuration option.
context: Authority: ymp-docs/self-organizing-team-domain-model.md, section 5.2 (ContributionPolicy), A1/A3/A4/A5/A9/A11/A12/A13, R-3/R-7/R-8/R-14/R-15/R-17. Use the approved model with 811a872 semantics and the greenfield baseline in 0c61ff1 and §5.8 for experimental strategy boundaries. Other documents and existing names explain implementation facts only.

Greenfield: create this behavior in the new implementation. Paths below are PROPOSED target modules under the layout owned by W1-0001; only completed prerequisite tasks supply implementation. Prior source, APIs, fixtures and delivery claims are not a baseline.

Create proposed runtime/policies/value.rs and complete composition in runtime/dispatcher.rs from all prerequisite mechanisms. Use A3’s calibrated gain/cost over A8’s applicable criterion ledger; kernel constraints still win over ranking. Keep one session loop.

The explicit role mapping is Plan/Decompose/Clarify → Planner; DesignChecks → CheckDesigner; Produce/Alternative/Integrate → Producer; Verify → Verifier; Review → Reviewer/FinalReviewer; Research/Diagnose → Researcher; Curate → Curator; Narrate → Narrator; Judge → Judge. P4 Advocates are bounded Research contributions.

Run-level and authorized work-boundary policy selection changes actual mechanisms without consumer rewrites; record resolved parameters/basis and preserve prior decisions/reputation. Reporting uses its policy-derived reserve and deterministic stop fallback; recovery remains scoped. W6-0005 evaluates when organization helps or harms, separately from implementing it.
